source: managed database provisioning (application and deployment code, not schema.prisma)
notes: Extensions the product depends on. schema.prisma declares none, so the projection can never contain them and they would otherwise read as unexplained divergence. Reviewed rather than replayed: two are created by application code at runtime and one was pre-created by the production cutover, so no single SQL file can be replayed to derive them. Not regenerated by derive-manifests.ts. Version is recorded under `observed` and deliberately excluded from `expect`: a version bump is a provisioning fact, not lineage divergence.

entries.serverPrerequisite: shared_preload_libraries contains pg_stat_statements (needs a server restart)
entries.validation: extension exists AND is operational: a harmless read of pg_stat_statements succeeds
entries.note: Feeds measured slow-query detection. Without it the invariant is reported UNCHECKED, never satisfied, so presence in pg_extension alone is not the whole contract.
Needs no preload. Index-bloat leaf density is unavailable without it.
Backs a shipped product capability (enable_vector_search: pgvector embedding column, cosine-similarity index, /vector-search endpoint), not incidental database decoration.
